title: Selective SSM with Mirror role coordinates
hypothesis: For four selective-SSM roles generated by rotating one shared state matrix, a shared SSM plus role-specific Givens angles achieves held-out sequence normalized RMSE within 10% of independent role matrices at <=60% actual serialized bytes with identical recurrent steps.
physical_object: one shared selective SSM with input-dependent delta, state matrix, B and C maps
mirror_coordinate: one role-specific Givens angle conjugating the shared state dynamics

task.teacher: input-dependent delta discretization with role-specific rotations of shared stable state matrix

success_gate: On each fresh world, Mirror sequence NRMSE <=1.1x independent role SSM and actual bytes <=60% independent, with equal recurrent step count and no instability.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality or byte gate, or scalar delta control matches/beat it at lower bytes.
boundaries: Role rotations are aligned to the Mirror family.
Synthetic SSM regression only; not Mamba language modeling evidence.
No throughput claim without fused implementation.
